limitations: Candidate votes including explicit write-ins are not ballots cast or distinct voters.
Washington candidate party labels are self-expressed preferences, not nomination or voter affiliation. Blank write-in party remains Other.
Actual complete county/district inventories are independent per year; this is a countywide race-vote comparison, not matched-seat or same-candidate causal inference.

2026 returns are unofficial, provisional and not certified; election source explicitly says results before November24 certification are unofficial. Reporting units reporting does not mean counting is complete.
2026 election-global asOf/lastUpdated/publishDate and county reporting-status clocks are preserved separately; county count-update timestamp is not established.
No missing geographic portions or absent major-party candidates were converted to zero; source-explicit zero candidate cells were retained.

2022CD3 archived county/district vectors predate the signed2022-12-22 amendment: all7CD3county portions AND its whole-district summary remain held; no14vote county allocation. Other9districts match the signed2022-12-07 certification; CD9named totals also match2022-12-16 amendment.

2022 source gives no count-update timestamp; Primary county/state controls exactly reconcile; FEC is independently checked with every disagreement preserved, not silently forced to match. County compatibility uses full Census2024 roster and retained Census substantial-change reference, not an adjudication of every minor cartographic correction.
